req.title: Reject malformed player payload
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity when POST /players/ receives a body that fails Player schema validation.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-009 requires HTTP 422 when POST /players/ receives a body failing PlayerRequestModel schema validation. PlayerRequestModel has three required fields (first_name, last_name, position) and one required int (squad_number). Tests cover: (1) positive EP — a fully valid payload returns 201, confirming the happy path and that 422 is not spuriously returned; (2) negative EP — completely empty body returns 422; (3) negative NEG — missing required field 'first_name' returns 422; (4) negative NEG — missing required field 'last_name' returns 422; (5) negative NEG — missing required field 'position' returns 422; (6) negative NEG — missing required field 'squad_number' returns 422; (7) boundary BVA — squad_number supplied as a non-integer string triggers 422; (8) DT — multiple required fields missing simultaneously returns 422; (9) boundary BVA — empty string for required str field 'first_name' (Pydantic v2 accepts empty str for str type, so this should be 201, testing the boundary between empty-string and missing); (10) NEG — null value for required field returns 422. This suite kills status-code constant mutations (201 vs 422), missing-field detection mutations, and type-coercion mutations.

tests.name: test_post_player_valid_payload_returns_201
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
squad_number 99 does not exist in the pre-loaded fixture
actions: POST /players/ with a fully valid PlayerRequestModel payload (all required fields present and correctly typed, squad_number=99)
expected: Response body contains firstName, lastName, position, squadNumber matching the submitted values
Response body contains an 'id' UUID field
trace: R-PLAYER-009 — positive path: valid payload must NOT trigger 422
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_valid_payload_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "Test"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Player"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert body["position"] == "Goalkeeper"
    assert "id" in body

tests.name: test_post_player_multiple_missing_fields_returns_422
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
actions: POST /players/ with only squadNumber provided, omitting firstName, lastName, and position
expected: Validation error detail lists at least 3 errors (one per missing required field)
trace: R-PLAYER-009 — multiple missing required fields must all be reported; catches mutations that short-circuit after first error
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_multiple_missing_fields_returns_422():
    payload = {"squadNumber": 95}
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 422
    body = r.json()
    assert "detail" in body
    assert isinstance(body["detail"], list)
    assert len(body["detail"]) >= 3
    error_fields = [str(err) for err in body["detail"]]
    combined = " ".join(error_fields)
    assert "first_name" in combined or "firstName" in combined
    assert "last_name" in combined or "lastName" in combined
    assert "position" in combined

tests.name: test_post_player_squad_number_as_float_string_returns_422
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
actions: POST /players/ with squadNumber supplied as a float value 10.5 (not a valid int)
expected: HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity — Pydantic strict int validation rejects non-integer floats
trace: R-PLAYER-009 — float squad_number is a type boundary; Pydantic v2 rejects 10.5 for int field; catches type-coercion mutations
tests.executable:

tests.name: test_post_player_valid_with_optional_fields_returns_201
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
squad_number 88 does not exist in the pre-loaded fixture
actions: POST /players/ with all required fields plus all optional fields populated
expected: Response body reflects all submitted fields including optional ones
trace: R-PLAYER-009 — full payload with optional fields must succeed with 201, not 422; catches over-eager validation mutations
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_valid_with_optional_fields_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Carlos",
        "middleName": "Alberto",
        "lastName": "Tevez",
        "dateOfBirth": "1984-02-05T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 88,
        "position": "Centre-Forward",
        "abbrPosition": "CF",
        "team": "Juventus",
        "league": "Serie A",
        "starting11": True
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "Carlos"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Tevez"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 88
    assert body["position"] == "Centre-Forward"
    assert body["starting11"] is True
    assert "id" in body
